summary: English, Spanish, French, German, Russian and Italian come fast; Cebuano at #2 and Swedish at #5 (both mostly written by bots), Dutch and Polish are the surprises, while Chinese (#12), Japanese, Arabic and Portuguese cost lives.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). A casual order found 6 and lost its lives on Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Portuguese and Hindi; each miss shows its edition's count.

Every open edition of Wikipedia (345), by its article count when the page was updated (November 2026). The player types the language; the edition's name ('English Wikipedia') works too, and 'mandarin' is Chinese.
Famous languages miss in a row, so lives go fast (fairness 3), but every miss is a near miss with a figure and the bots are a good reveal. Blitz not simulated.
